Taste (Y4 composition) remains provisional until YZ sees the contact sheets.

findings.subject: app-view (page template), chat-page, onboarding-page, sign-in-page
findings.summary: Narrowed from r2-layout-1: four of seven page templates still have no 768 or 1440 evidence (dashboard-page and settings-page are fixed).
findings.evidence: packages/templates/src/pages/{app-view,chat-page,onboarding-page,sign-in-page}/*.stories.tsx export no Tablet/Wide; scripts/design-system/lib/templates-check.mjs:18-29 RESPONSIVE_TEMPLATES omits them.
findings.fix: Add Tablet and Wide stories and put these pages in RESPONSIVE_TEMPLATES.

findings.subject: activity-list, auth-card, chat-panel, getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: Narrowed from r2-layout-2: these blocks are still captured only at 1280 and 390 (settings-section and stat-row are fixed).

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-3: AppView's Phone* stories are captured at 1280, so layout="phone" has no 390 baseline in ui-react, and the md/lg breakpoints are never captured.
findings.fix: Rename to end in Phone (or add ui-react-appview-- to RESPONSIVE_STORY_PREFIXES) and add Tablet/Wide window stories.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-4: below 1280 the aside column is hidden with no fallback, so page navigation passed as aside vanishes on tablets and small laptops.
findings.fix: Offer an inline or disclosure fallback for the aside below xl, or document that the caller must render one.

findings.subject: app-view (page template)
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-6: the phone sample and the `atom63 build` snippet pad the first block with raw env(safe-area-inset-top), bypassing --a63-safe-area-top.
findings.fix: Use pt-(--a63-app-view-inset-top) or var(--a63-safe-area-top), or let AppView own the top inset when there is no top bar.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Narrowed from r2-layout-8 (Page is fixed): ReaderLayout takes no safe-area insets, and the reading-page template and its build snippet wrap it in <Page noPadding>, so a reading route outside a shell has no inset owner.
findings.fix: Drop noPadding in the reading page (let Page own the insets) or give ReaderLayout the inline insets, and add a checkSafeArea play.

findings.subject: activity-list
findings.summary: Narrowed from r2-layout-9 (the dashboard part is fixed): ActivityList with no items renders an empty labelled list.
findings.evidence: packages/templates/src/blocks/activity-list/activity-list.tsx:42; the dashboard draws its own empty state instead (dashboard-page.tsx:215).
findings.fix: Accept an empty prop (or render EmptyState) when items is empty, and add an Empty story.

findings.subject: getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-10: when every step is done the checklist has no current step and no completion state; partly-done and done are not shown.
findings.fix: Add a completion state (message and dismiss) and AllDone/PartlyDone stories.

findings.subject: app-view (page template)
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-13: the app view sample shows only a fixed five-track album; no empty library, long title or long list is exercised.
findings.fix: Add EmptyLibrary, LongTitles and ManyTracks stories.

findings.subject: sign-in-page
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-16: the sign-in card is meant to be centred but sits at the top of the page.
findings.fix: Use min-h-dvh (or a sized parent) on the sign-in Page, and assert the card's vertical centre in a play.

findings.subject: tab-bar
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-17: tab labels use an arbitrary 11px size that ignores the type scale.
findings.fix: Use text-2xs or a caption text role.

findings.subject: AppView
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-18: AppView names any docked bar 'Player' and any side panel 'Library' by default.
findings.fix: Require the labels when the slot is used, or default to neutral names.

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-19: Section's child-gap ramp is not monotonic: generous is tighter than loose.
findings.fix: Make generous gap-8 and spacious gap-10 (or one ramp from tokens).

findings.subject: Section
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-20: removeTopSpacing defaults to true, so the default Section has no top padding.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/layout/section.tsx:12-15, :45; the reading-page snippet has to pass removeTopSpacing={false}.
findings.fix: Default it to false in the next minor, with a changeset.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Narrowed from r2-layout-21 (the build query is fixed): `atom63 api ReaderLayout` still answers with an import line only.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 api ReaderLayout` output; reader-layout.tsx:4-12 has TSDoc on one prop.
findings.fix: Document the props in TSDoc so the API index carries them.

findings.subject: ReaderLayout
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-22: ReaderLayout hard-codes Tailwind widths instead of Container's named max widths.
findings.fix: Use containerFrameClassName or the named widths.

findings.subject: getting-started-checklist
findings.summary: Carried from r2-layout-23: every done step is drawn in the accent colour, exceeding one or two accent cues per view.
findings.fix: Draw done steps in text-secondary and keep the accent for the current step.

findings.subject: list-page
findings.summary: Residual of r2-layout-15 (the two primaries are fixed): the no-invoices first run still shows the filter bar and the 'no results' SearchX icon.
findings.fix: Hide the filter bar and pass a first-run emptyIcon when invoices.length === 0.

findings.subject: sign-in-page
findings.summary: Residual of r2-layout-7 (inline and bottom are fixed): with no header above it, nothing owns the top safe-area inset on the sign-in page.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/layout/page.tsx:17-19 gives the top inset to the header; sign-in-page.tsx:76 has none.
findings.fix: Add pt-[max(--spacing(8),var(--a63-safe-area-top))] for header-less routes, or a Page prop for it.
